You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

In a few decades our society will have a disproportionate number of old people: the life expectancy is constantly rising, and at the same time birth rates are declining. Although having children has become more fashionable again in recent years, these short-term fluctuations in birth rates don't change the general trend at all.
What argument components exists in sentence "In a few decades our society will have a disproportionate number of old people: the life expectancy is constantly rising, and at the same time birth rates are declining" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.

<pro>In a few decades our society will have a disproportionate number of old people:</pro> <pro>the life expectancy is constantly rising,</pro> <pro>and at the same time birth rates are declining</pro>
